title: Computability of the halting function
statement: Let $c$ be a machine representation scheme, $M$ a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, and $T$ a function from natural numbers to natural numbers. If $M$ decides the unary language associated with the halting function of $c$ within time bound $T$, then some finite-state Boolean Turing machine computes the function sending each bit string $s$ to the one-bit string whose bit is the value of that halting function at $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ decides the unary language associated with the halting function of $c$ within time bound $T$
